notes:
單一個 Perceptron 的邊界是直線，所以解不了 XOR（學不停）；就算資料可分，學到的直線也可能因起點不同而泛化不佳。

XOR 的同類點在對角線上，拿尺在紙上怎麼畫都有一個點被分錯。另外，Perceptron 只求「全對」，不求「最好」，所以兩次訓練可以停在不同的線上，對新點的答案相反。

XOR 不可由 $f(w_1x_1+w_2x_2+w_0)$ 算出（第1章 KP08 的證明）；Perceptron 在不可分資料上每輪都有更新；零訓練誤差不蘊含泛化。

XOR 每輪更新 $3,3,4,4,\dots$；格點搜尋最多對 3/4；兩條零誤差邊界對 $(2.5,2.4)$ 給出類 1 與類 0。

XOR無法被單一仿射門檻表示。特定種子、初值或搜尋格點只說明該次實驗，不構成所有情況的證明；ADALINE換連續目標不自動保證較佳泛化。

The boundary of one Perceptron is a straight line, so it cannot solve XOR (it never stops); and even on separable data the learned line may generalize poorly depending on where it started.

The points of one XOR class sit on the diagonals, so however you draw a line with a ruler, one point is wrong. Also, the Perceptron only asks for "all right", not "best", so two trainings can stop at different lines that give opposite answers on a new point.

XOR cannot be computed as $f(w_1x_1+w_2x_2+w_0)$ (the proof of Chapter 1 KP08); a Perceptron on non-separable data has updates in every pass; zero training error does not imply generalization.

XOR has $3,3,4,4,\dots$ updates per pass; a grid search gets at most 3/4 right; two zero-error boundaries give class 1 and class 0 for $(2.5,2.4)$.

A single affine threshold cannot represent XOR. Individual seeds, starts or grid searches illustrate particular runs, not universal proofs. ADALINE’s continuous objective does not guarantee better generalization.
